SMTO-CFG-0096 — A Skill is turned on but can't work yet

GUID: 02816c6f-cac4-5fa2-8541-a48b746d0fff
Slug: capability-activation-active-unavailable
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • SMTO turned on a Skill for this task, but it still needs a sign-in, more setup, or a service or computer it depends on. Its tools can't be used until that is sorted out.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select Capabilities in the message box controls and search for the Skill. If it is marked Unavailable, read the reason shown next to it. The reason tells you whether the Skill needs a sign-in, more setup, or a computer it can't reach.
  2. If the Skill has a Configure button, select it, fill in the missing details, and select Save. A Skill marked Partially configured can't run until its required details are filled in.
  3. If SMTO shows Open authorization page in the conversation, open it and finish signing in to the account the Skill uses. Skills that use an online account need your sign-in before SMTO can act for you.
  4. If the Skill runs commands on another computer, open Settings › Setup › Gateways and check that its Gateway shows as Connected. The Gateway is the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, and the Skill can't work while it's offline.

What success looks like

  • The Skill no longer shows as Unavailable in Capabilities, and the task can use its tools.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details in this panel and send them, with the Skill's name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't type passwords or sign-in codes into the conversation; enter them only on the Skill's own setup or sign-in page.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Skill is active in the accepted capability selection but its live availability check fails (authentication_required, configuration_required or skill_unavailable, for example an unavailable selected Gateway), so its tools cannot execute yet (no current code path emits this message text directly; activation records capability_activation.unavailable).

What this means

  • This retained active-unavailable label has no direct current message producer; activation does separately record live authentication, configuration or Skill-availability prerequisites after committing selection. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • This retained active-unavailable label has no direct current message producer; activation does separately record live authentication, configuration or Skill-availability prerequisites after committing selection.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the specific live availability reason and accepted selection independently.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the capability_activation.unavailable event reason and the Skill's availability in the capability catalog (/api/agent/capabilities/catalog). Complete the Skill's OAuth sign-in or required configuration, or restore the selected Gateway connection; the accepted selection does not need to change.
  • Resolve the reported authentication, configuration or provider prerequisite through that capability's supported setup.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • The capability remains within accepted authority and its actual prerequisites pass before execution.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
